description: [PAID $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Spot USD price of a crypto asset by ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, APT, LINK, ...), read live from Coinbase and Kraken. A price is returned only when both answer and agree within 1%; the answer is their midpoint, with both readings and the deviation. If one venue is down or they disagree, you get an error with the readings instead of a guess. Ticker prices are for the market asset, not a specific token contract.
